targets.rawSql: SELECT observed_at AS time, metadata->>'mac' AS mac, metadata->>'rssi' AS rssi, metadata->>'confidence' AS confidence FROM shared_observations WHERE observer='nova' AND category='security' AND metadata ? 'confidence' AND observed_at > now() - interval '30 days' ORDER BY observed_at DESC
SELECT observed_at AS time, subject, observation FROM shared_observations WHERE observer='nova_ble_churn_report' AND observed_at > now() - interval '30 days' ORDER BY observed_at DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT scene_name AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM home_scene_activations WHERE ts > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY scene_name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT ts AS time, agent_name AS agent, rule_level, rule_description FROM security_events WHERE rule_level >= 7 AND ts > now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT coalesce(metadata->>'mfr_category', 'unknown') AS metric, count(DISTINCT device_mac) AS value FROM telemetry.bluetooth WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 day' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
